complete_four_business.full_chain_observation:

TimeStopController appends newly created zone into dimension list and separately requests provider ADD; return zone/non-null is not an accepted-target receipt. Zone lifetime decrements at SERVER START, then scans until expired; controller checks before and after tick, so last positive lifetime pass can capture and release within the same call. Producer removal or mantle swap does not revoke the autonomous zone.
TimeStopZone scans bounding chunks with world.getChunk, not a demonstrated loaded-only query. In-sphere tiles must be ITickable, permitted by blacklist and currently in world.tickableTileEntities. A same-position replacement can be removed without another cache record; overlapping zones observe the already-removed tick participant. No source-owned reference-counted lease.
On stop, retained object is reinserted only when current block reports a tile and constructing a fresh current-block tile yields a class assignable from the cached class.
